transcript: On the morning when we reached the airport My friend was waiting to leave for a new job abroad I watched him quietly Loading his luggage on the cart He turned toward me Though smiling, his eyes seemed a little wet We gave each other a brief hug and exchanged a small promise Walking toward the gate, he did not turn back Wishing him well in my heart, I saw him off Not turning back was probably the better way, I thought My friend, having shared many years with me Was leaving to follow a new path We had promised to keep in touch Through the large glass window of the airport I watched his plane depart in the morning light The plane slowly rose into the sky The future awaiting, my friend, seemed to spread beyond the clouds

segments.text: On the morning when we reached the airport
My friend was waiting to leave for a new job abroad
Loading his luggage on the cart
Though smiling, his eyes seemed a little wet
We gave each other a brief hug and exchanged a small promise
Walking toward the gate, he did not turn back
Wishing him well in my heart, I saw him off
Not turning back was probably the better way, I thought
My friend, having shared many years with me
Was leaving to follow a new path
We had promised to keep in touch
Through the large glass window of the airport
I watched his plane depart in the morning light
The plane slowly rose into the sky
The future awaiting, my friend, seemed to spread beyond the clouds
